Do not retcon, approve, or roll up changes automatically. Keep reports scoped to this story. `doctor` and `brief-review` provide local evidence; they do not authenticate GitHub approval or verify settings/CODEOWNERS enforcement. Keep draft/context bundles in workspace `.local/`; do not publish them in this issue without explicit user authorization. Do not invent provenance, reviewer scores, or friction entries.
